ignoreValues.reason: The hub uses a deliberate weight-led hierarchy: the masthead h1 is fluid at clamp(1.9rem, 1rem + 4.8vw, 4.75rem), while review, loop and semester h2 use 1.35–1.6rem, subject h3 uses 1.25rem, and chapter/part h4 use 1.1rem (css/index.css). The detector reads the wrong static sequence for this responsive sign system.

Claude: measured in Chromium (light, dark, print): every text run is 7.6:1 or better; the static scan pairs print colours with the dark screen background, and the 1.0:1 runs are sqrt root glyphs drawn as a currentColor mask
Claude: an exam sheet is a deliberate density exception (docs/APPENDIX-STANDARD.md, Exam sheets): 1.2 line height in print so each A4 side holds the whole syllabus
